content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.aiimsguwahati.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the AIIMS Guwahati recruitment is 03-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this AIIMS Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) and Project Technical Support-III in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: For Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in relevant fields with three years of research experience or a completed PhD.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The Project Technical Support-III post offers a salary of Rs. 28,000/- plus 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this AIIMS Guwahati recruitment is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an online application via Google Form, followed by offline hard copy submission by post, shortlisting, interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. How should I apply for the AIIMS Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. Candidates must fill the downloaded application form, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post/Registered Post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for AIIMS Guwahati?
faq.answer: The official website for All India Institute of Medical Sciences Guwahati is https://www.aiimsguwahati.ac.in. You can find more details and download the application form from here.

faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature, as indicated in the recruitment notification released by AIIMS Guwahati.
